description: A four-panel composite of grain-size distribution histograms (EBSD statistics) for rolled Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe steels. Every panel is a bar chart of red gradient bars with a single legend entry "Diameter"; all x-axes are labelled "Diameter (µm)" and all y-axes "Area Fraction (%)". (a) 0Be: x-axis 0–33 µm in 3 µm steps, y-axis 0–0.25 in 0.05 steps; a unimodal distribution whose tallest bar is centred on 15 µm and rises between the 0.20 and 0.25 gridlines, with a secondary shoulder at 18 µm and a long tail to 30 µm. (b) 0.5Be: much wider x-axis 0–50 µm in 5 µm steps and a lower y-axis 0–0.16 in 0.02 steps; the distribution is shifted to coarse sizes, with several bars at about the 0.13 gridline between 25 and 45 µm and the tallest bar near 45 µm. (c) 1.0Be: x-axis 0–22 µm in 2 µm steps, y-axis 0–0.25; one dominant bar at 10 µm, with a broad shoulder between 12 and 16 µm. (d) 1.5Be: x-axis 0–25 µm in 5 µm steps, y-axis 0–0.35 in 0.05 steps; a single dominant bar in the 12–13 µm region at about the 0.30–0.32 level. Together the panels demonstrate that 0.5Be strongly coarsens the grain structure while 1.0Be and 1.5Be refine it.

subfigures.description: Grain-size histogram for 0Be (Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–0Be). Diameter axis 0–33 µm in 3 µm steps, Area Fraction axis 0–0.25. Unimodal distribution with the tallest bar at 15 µm (above the 0.20 gridline), secondary bar at 18 µm near 0.13, tail extending to 30 µm. Panel letter partially cropped at the left edge.

Grain-size histogram for 0.5Be. Diameter axis 0–50 µm in 5 µm steps, Area Fraction axis 0–0.16 in 0.02 steps. Distribution shifted to coarse diameters: bars near 0.13 at 25, 30 and 40 µm, tallest bar near 45 µm, with only a small population below 15 µm.

Grain-size histogram for 1.0Be. Diameter axis 0–22 µm in 2 µm steps, Area Fraction axis 0–0.25. One dominant bar at 10 µm (between the 0.20 and 0.25 gridlines), then a plateau of bars near 0.10 from 12 to 16 µm and a decreasing tail to 20 µm.

Grain-size histogram for 1.5Be. Diameter axis labelled 0–25 µm in 5 µm steps with 8 bars, Area Fraction axis 0–0.35 in 0.05 steps. One dominant bar in the 12–13 µm region above the 0.30 gridline, with smaller bars near 5, 7.5 and 25 µm. Exact bar bin centres are not printed.

observations.observation: All four panels are bar-chart histograms with x-axis 'Diameter (µm)', y-axis 'Area Fraction (%)' and a single legend entry 'Diameter' shown as red gradient bars.
Panel (a) uses a 0–33 µm diameter axis with 3 µm steps and a 0–0.25 area-fraction axis; its modal bar is centred at 15 µm.
Panel (b) uses a much wider 0–50 µm diameter axis (5 µm steps) and a 0–0.16 area-fraction axis, with the bulk of area fraction in the coarse 25–45 µm bars.
Panel (c) uses a 0–22 µm diameter axis with 2 µm steps and is dominated by a single tall bar at 10 µm.
Panel (d) uses a 0–25 µm diameter axis and a 0–0.35 area-fraction axis, with one dominant bar located between the 10 and 15 µm gridlines.
The caption states the four panels are EBSD grain-size statistics for Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–xBe steels with (a) 0Be, (b) 0.5Be, (c) 1.0Be and (d) 1.5Be.
The citing text states that the grain size of 0Be is approximately 55% in the range of 12–18 µm.
The citing text states that for 0.5Be the grain size is relatively large and that grains >20 µm account for >75%.
The citing text states that the grain sizes of the 1.0Be and 1.5Be steels are around 11 and 13 µm, respectively.
Visual trend: the modal peak position moves from 15 µm (0Be) to the 40–45 µm range (0.5Be) and back down to 10 µm (1.0Be) and about 12–13 µm (1.5Be).
No numeric data labels are printed on any bar; all values must be read against the y-axis gridlines and the caption/citation values.
